# ManageMyWeb (https://www.managemyweb.co)

> ManageMyWeb develops custom, browser-based 3D e-commerce websites and virtual storefronts for Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom retail brands—and offers optional monthly managed website operations.

## Core Focus
- **Custom 3D Virtual Store Development**: Interactive browser showrooms where customers browse virtual shelves, inspect products, read brand story context beside items, and continue to checkout via your existing store platform where supported.
- **No App Required**: Opens inside Chrome, Safari, and Edge on desktop and mobile devices with semantic HTML fallbacks and reduced-motion awareness.
- **Optional Managed Website Operations**: Cloud hosting setup, domain/DNS tracking, SSL checks, email configuration (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), off-site backups, speed hygiene, and routine storefront edits.
- **Prototype-First Engagement**: Request a custom 3D store demo featuring a few selected products before scoping a full build quote.

- [Home — 3D E-Commerce Website Development](https://www.managemyweb.co/): Overview, live interactive demo walkthrough, client work, and demo/quote request flow.

- [Shopify 3D Store Integration](https://www.managemyweb.co/shopify-3d-store): How 3D showrooms connect with Shopify catalogs and native checkout.
- [WooCommerce 3D Store Integration](https://www.managemyweb.co/woocommerce-3d-store): How 3D assets stay fast on edge CDN alongside WordPress & WooCommerce checkouts.
- [3D Virtual Showroom Examples](https://www.managemyweb.co/3d-store-examples): Showroom concepts by retail industry.
- [Live 3D Store Demo](https://www.managemyweb.co/experience): Watch the 30-second video walkthrough or open the interactive 3D preview.
- [Managed Website Operations](https://www.managemyweb.co/services/web-management): Hosting, DNS, security backups, speed hygiene, and ongoing updates.
- [E-Commerce Conversion & Checkout Optimization](https://www.managemyweb.co/services/ecommerce-growth): Mobile script cleanup, checkout friction fixes, and consent-aware analytics.
- [Pricing & Quotation](https://www.managemyweb.co/pricing): Custom project scoping based on product count, room design, and platform setup.
- [Projects & Client Work](https://www.managemyweb.co/case-studies): Stores and digital projects across Europe, North America, and Australia.
- [3D E-Commerce FAQs](https://www.managemyweb.co/faq): Answers on platform support, Google SEO, mobile usability, and ownership.
- [Guides & Insights](https://www.managemyweb.co/blog): Technical and strategic guides on 3D storefronts and website maintenance.
